title: Trump Says Russia and Ukraine Will Stop Attacking Power Plants
summary:
On Sunday, U.S. President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire." A ceasefire is a deal to stop attacking. This one means not attacking power plants and other energy sites. Russia and Ukraine have been at war for about four and a half years.

Trump's short post online said the ceasefire started right away. He did not give other details. Russia did not comment right away.

Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said the news was "good news for everyone." But he said Russia was still attacking energy sites in Kyiv and Kharkiv. He said Ukraine was ready to stop too, if Russia did the same.

This has happened before. On September 14, Trump said the two countries agreed not to hit energy sites, but nothing changed.

Trump and Zelenskyy have also disagreed. Trump said Ukraine should get a new president. Zelenskyy said Ukraine's people should choose their own leader.
why_it_matters: Power plants keep lights, heat and water working for families, so protecting them helps keep people safe.
